title: Digi Macro
author: gdeo607
description: MACRO, a machine in the FUNC+SRC list (after Digi Mono's): engines ported from Plaits by Emilie Gillet (MIT licence) - WSHAPE, 2OP FM, NOISE, PARTCL, BDRUM, SNARE, HIHAT, GRAIN. Knob B picks the engine (p-lockable per step), C/D/E are HARMONICS/TIMBRE/MORPH; Plaits' main output. Needs Digi Mono 0.24 or later (and machine-pages, which draws its page), which renders its voices and draws its knobs; elekloader ticks it (and machine-pages) with it.
